# Tekno Krafft 2026 - LLM Context and Directory

## Overview
Tekno Krafft 2026 is an immersive futuristic technology festival organized by GDG ITER (Google Developer Groups On Campus - ITER), Siksha 'O' Anusandhan (SOA) Deemed to be University, Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.
Lead Organizer: Bighnesh Patro (bighnesh@gdgiter.com).

The event spans 2 intensive days (October 24-25, 2026) of technical workshops, research keynotes, live engineering demonstrations, and the Nexus 36-hour hackathon.

## Venue Information
- Campus: Institute of Technical Education and Research (ITER), Siksha 'O' Anusandhan (SOA) University
- Address: Campus 1, Jagamohan Nagar, Jagamara, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

## Core Technical Focus Areas
1. Autonomous Systems and Artificial Intelligence
2. Full-Stack Systems and High-Throughput Engineering
3. Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps
4. Defensive Cybersecurity and Zero Trust
5. Robotics, Embedded Systems, and Internet of Things
6. Distributed Data Architecture and Real-Time Telemetry
7. Open Source Infrastructure and Upstream RFCs
